meta.source: bali repo v2-archive: apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css + bali-tokens.cjs (exact values, no invention)

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Evergreen primitive. Brand + focused state family.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: Evergreen primitive. Dark-mode brand text / focus ring.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Evergreen primitive. Light focus ring, arc fill, the mark's arc.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Evergreen primitive. Light brand surface + primary action.

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Evergreen primitive. Primary hover (light); brand surface (dark).

tokens.name: stone-50
tokens.usage: Warm stone primitive. Light page background.

tokens.name: stone-100
tokens.usage: Warm stone primitive. Sunken wells, neutral chip fills.

tokens.name: stone-200
tokens.usage: Warm stone primitive. Default borders, arc track.

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Warm stone primitive. (AA fail for small text — see text-tertiary note.)

tokens.name: stone-600
tokens.usage: Warm stone primitive. Tertiary text, ended/no-device ink.

tokens.name: stone-700
tokens.usage: Warm stone primitive. Not-joined chip ink.

tokens.name: orange-50
tokens.usage: Warm orange primitive. Emergency family — supportive, never alarm.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Warm orange primitive. Light emergency-chip fill.

tokens.name: orange-300
tokens.usage: Warm orange primitive. Dark-mode emergency ink.

tokens.name: orange-800
tokens.usage: Warm orange primitive. Light emergency-chip ink.

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Calm blue primitive. Pass-state family only.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Calm blue primitive. Light pass-chip fill.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Calm blue primitive. Dark-mode pass ink.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Calm blue primitive. Light pass-chip ink.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: Red primitive. RESERVED: revoked state + destructive actions. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App/page background. Warm paper in light; true warm dark at night.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets. Dark elevates by lightening, not shadows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers. Pair with shadow-2 in light, hairline border in dark.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Brand-solid blocks. Text on it uses text-on-brand.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, card edges (dark relies on these instead of shadows).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary ink. Warm near-black, never pure #000.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions and labels. stone-600, not 500 — 500 fails WCAG AA at small sizes.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text only — never for content someone must read.

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on surface-brand and primary buttons (light).

tokens.name: action-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Dark uses green-400 + dark ink — green-500 fails AA with either fg.

tokens.name: action-destructive-bg
tokens.usage: Destructive actions ONLY (remove student, delete class).

tokens.name: state-notjoined-fg
tokens.usage: 'Not in' chip ink. Every state chip = color + icon + label, never color alone.

tokens.name: state-focused-fg
tokens.usage: 'Focused' chip ink. The good green — earned, calm.

tokens.name: state-focused-bg
tokens.usage: 'Focused' chip fill. Dark tints are hand-mixed, never alpha overlays.

tokens.name: state-pass-fg
tokens.usage: 'Pass' chip ink (bathroom/nurse). Calm blue, only place blue appears.

tokens.name: state-emergency-fg
tokens.usage: 'Unlocked' chip ink. Warm, supportive orange — NEVER alarm red; the exit is sanctioned.

tokens.name: state-revoked-fg
tokens.usage: 'Protection off' chip ink. One of red's two permitted uses.

tokens.name: state-nodevice-fg
tokens.usage: 'No device' ink. No fill — dashed outline instead (state-nodevice-bg).

tokens.name: state-nodevice-bg
tokens.usage: 'No device' is outlined, not filled: transparent + dashed border-default.

tokens.name: arc-fill
tokens.usage: SessionCountdown arc progress — the brand's signature motion.

tokens.name: arc-final2
tokens.usage: Final-2-minutes arc emphasis: LIGHTER and thicker, never red.

tokens.name: focus-ring-color
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color; composed in shadow token focus-ring.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body. The app reads at 15px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text — text-tertiary or darker.

spacing.note: 4pt base grid — px on web, pt on iOS. Nothing sits off-grid.

shadow.note: Light mode: soft warm shadows (warm-black, never blue-gray). Dark mode: elevation via lighter surfaces + hairline borders; shadow-1 disappears entirely.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus, everywhere, no exceptions: 2px page-color gap + 2px ring.
